component.name: BPS Companion
component.summary: Spend from your home BPS Relay's allowance

description.p: BPS Companion pays and receives BPS from a phone or a computer without holding any coin keys. Your own BPS Relay at home keeps a small allowance wallet and signs for this device, within limits only the relay can change: so much per payment, so much a day, and a PIN with a lockout.

When your relay is listed as a relay, the app reaches it through three other relays, so none of them, and nobody watching your home connection, learns where the device is. Otherwise it connects straight to your relay: on the same network, or from anywhere through a forwarded port. It holds only a key of its own, which can spend nothing by itself.
